title: Art. 2.7.5 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 7, Paragraph 5
content: Any person detained shall be brought promptly before a judge or other officer authorized by law to exercise judicial power and shall be entitled to trial within a reasonable time or to be released without prejudice to the continuation of the proceedings. His release may be subject to guarantees to assure his appearance for trial.
